# ShipCheck

ShipCheck is a free visual regression testing tool by Safdar Ali.

URL: https://shipcheck.safdarali.in

## What it does

- Compare two UI screenshots or webpage URLs pixel by pixel
- Highlight visual differences in red
- Show diff percentage and export PNG/JSON reports
- Supports image upload (PNG, JPEG, WebP) and URL screenshot capture

## Keywords

visual regression testing free, compare screenshots online, ui diff checker

## Author

Safdar Ali — https://safdarali.in
